name: Gank
description:
About This Game

Thank you for your interest in our game! We are a tiny indie 2-man studio working on our dream!

GANK brings a unique flavor to the 5v5 MOBA genre - you control all 5 heroes on the team in a tabletop boardgame format! Instead of point-and-click in real time, players take turns picking cards that represent the usual actions you take in a match; Farming neutral camps for Gold, attacking other Champions, finding treasures that spawn at intervals, pushing the actual lanes; It's all turn-based!

The game was meticulously designed across more than 5 years and started since 2019 as seen on the boardgame scene on various websites. Over thousands of logged games eventually got the game to this point.

We realize there are 2 groups - the competitive hardcore, and the casual. For the hardcore, you can expect the same cut-throat mode of winning half the battle even before the match starts... by drafting and banning Champions correctly. Hard-countering is alive in this game! But wait, what about those who just started with little info on Champions' skills? Or the more relaxed group who just want to enjoy using their favorite group of Champions? We have a different system for casuals and it has ZERO penalty, with a focus on just having fun. In fact, as part of our future roadmap, we will be implementing the DraftMaster which gives advice on which Champions to counter or ban during drafting!

Here's what Gank features:

  • Heavy world-building around high-fantasy Eudoria, filled with lots of interesting characters

  • Huge investments in REAL top artists from famous works like Star Wars and Magic

  • Several original tracks featuring across popular themes like vikings or even pirates

  • Original take on turn-based system in the MOBA genre

  • Hardcore drafting league for advanced players looking for a true challenge

  • Separate casual friendly matches with no penalty

  • Practice or play full matches against AI bots

  • Champions can level up and unlock their 'Ultimate' skill in matches

  • Farm materials to shop and craft legendary equipment that can turn the tide

  • Unique victory condition where players can do set collection and gather enough Krystals to destroy the enemy base instantly, making comebacks very real and keeping anyone on their toes until the very end of a match

  • Full bonus solo campaign with roguelite style, complete with permanent upgrades

  • Campaign also has its own set of uniquely designed enemies

  • Each Champion has its own lore and ending in the campaign, bringing huge replay value

  • Drawn and designed by top talented artists who drew for Fantasy Flight, Star Wars, Dungeons & Dragons, Magic The Gathering!

Ever wanted to see what happens when a Monk goes up against a Deathknight? Or a Pirate against a Pugilist? All the mainstream folks are here for the showdown! But because of that, there are a lot of skills and abilities in Gank. Taking on the game as a first timer could overwhelm you! Enjoy the learning process and know that at any point you can always reference both your Champions' skills as well as your opponents' by clicking on either side of the screen!
short_desc: WISHLIST NOW! A love letter to all fans out there who enjoy DOTA or LoL - a MOBA card game! Explore the lore-filled Eudoria, and pit mainstream fantasy like trolls, banshees, even hydras in a long-awaited showdown. Though designed for quick online matches, we also squeezed in a roguelite campaign!
